# Menlo models AI spending


By OpenTools Team


·


November 4, 2026


Annualized, not booked.


##


Dollars


Menlo’s November 3 report models $176.8 billion in annualized deployment spending as of September 2026, not January–September cash, despite the chart’s YTD label. Morning Consult surveyed nearly 400 US decision‑makers overseeing over $4 billion in AI spending, September 8–26, 2026. Production API shares weight reported workloads by AI spending; prior years reclassify data‑labeling vendors into development.[1](https://menlovc.com/perspective/2026-the-state-of-enterprise-ai/)


##


Tokens


Separate OpenRouter weekly API‑key token cohorts span September 1, 2025–September 28, 2026, skewing toward developers/startups. They cannot establish enterprise market shares or ROI. Menlo invests in Anthropic and OpenRouter; the page lacks microdata, confidence intervals and a fully reproducible model.[1](https://menlovc.com/perspective/2026-the-state-of-enterprise-ai/)


Document review, January 2022; archive, not Menlo research.
